The analytics team queries table metadata that is registered in the AWS Glue Data Catalog before each scheduled extraction job runs against the warehouse.
A workflow that coordinates three serverless functions in a strict order is implemented with AWS Step Functions rather than with direct invocation chaining.
Column level permissions on the shared tables are granted through AWS Lake Formation so that the finance group cannot read salary fields.
The compliance engineer enables AWS Config so that every change to a security group is recorded and evaluated against the organization rules.
AWS Trusted Advisor reports that several load balancers have been idle for more than thirty days and recommends removing them to reduce spend.
The finance analyst opens AWS Cost Explorer to compare the monthly spend of two accounts across the last six billing periods in one chart.
Database credentials are stored in AWS Secrets Manager and rotated automatically every thirty days without any change to the application code.
Partners upload nightly files over SFTP through AWS Transfer Family, which writes the objects directly into the landing prefix of the bucket.
Each item written to DynamoDB carries a partition key and an optional sort key, and the table scales its throughput on demand.
The entire stack is described in CloudFormation so that the same environment can be recreated in another region without manual steps.
Raw export files land in Amazon S3 and are moved to a colder storage class after ninety days by a lifecycle rule.
An IAM role grants the function permission to read one table and to write log events, and nothing else beyond that.
The team keeps every raw file in one central data lake so that later analysis never needs the original source system again.
Archived reports are placed in object storage because the access pattern is infrequent and the retrieval delay is acceptable.
Fine grained access control is applied at the column level, and the audit team reviews the granted permissions every quarter.
Shortening the retention period of the stream removes records that the downstream consumers have not finished processing yet.
